metadata.title: Enzo Interiors — Fitted kitchens, bedrooms & media walls in Leicester
metadata.description: Bespoke fitted kitchens, bedrooms, wardrobes and media walls, designed and handmade in our Leicester workshop and fitted by our own team across Leicestershire.

hold.heading: Every cable, out of sight.
hold.body: Screen, storage, fire and lighting, built as one piece and scribed to your walls.

hold.heading: Made for the way you cook.
hold.body: Cabinetry, worktops and appliances, drawn around your room rather than a catalogue.

hold.heading: Wall to wall, floor to ceiling.
hold.body: Wardrobes, headboards and bedsides, built into the room instead of standing in it.

transitions.heading: From the Anchor, to the Heart of the Home
transitions.body: Hand-jointed timber and hidden cable runs settle into place — then the story moves to where the household actually gathers.

transitions.heading: From Built to Cook In, to Where the Day Ends
transitions.body: The same care that shapes cabinetry and worktops carries through to the room where the household actually rests.

cta.sub: One free consultation. Zero pressure. Built for you.

heroStatic.body: Kitchens, wardrobes and media walls, built in our workshop and fitted by the same team.

servicesBoard.label: Disciplines
servicesBoard.lede: Nothing here is bought in and re-badged. Every carcass is cut, sprayed and fitted by the same people who measured the wall it goes on.
servicesBoard.footerNote: Not sure which of them you need? We work that out on the first visit.

process.label: Process
process.lede: Five stages, one team. Keep scrolling and the drawing builds itself, exactly the way your room does.

stages.title: Consultation
stages.body: We come to you, measure the room properly, photograph every wall and ask how you actually use the space.

stages.title: Design
stages.body: You get a 3D visual of the finished room and a fixed, itemised quote — refined until you stop finding things to change.

stages.title: Making
stages.body: Cut, edged and assembled in our Leicester workshop by the people who drew it. Every panel is made for your room.

stages.title: Fitting
stages.body: Scribed to your walls, levelled and sealed. Floors covered, dust contained, every gap lined up.

stages.title: Handover
stages.body: We walk the room with you, clear the snag list, then leave care notes and a five-year workmanship guarantee.

mobileCard.label: Typical project
mobileCard.heading: Five to eight weeks, start to fitted.

drawing.ariaLabel: Wardrobe elevation drawing, inking in stage by stage as the process advances

workshop.label: Construction
workshop.lede: Turn it, open the doors, look inside. A media wall, drawn to the millimetre.
workshop.ledeShowcase: A media wall, drawn to the millimetre — turning through open and shut.

work.label: Work

voices.label: Clients
voices.lede: The real test of fitted furniture is the year after the fitters leave. Every review we have is here — not a selection of the good ones.

invite.label: Next
invite.lede: An hour at your kitchen table, a tape measure and a few photographs. You get a drawing and a fixed price. Nothing else happens until you say so.
invite.ledeShort: An hour at your kitchen table and a tape measure. You get a drawing and a fixed price.
